about: Test vectors for a chain card's link (docs/chain-link.md), read by tests/test_chainlink.py and web/src/pipeline/chainlink.test.ts. Written by hand once and checked by eye; both languages must give exactly these results and messages. presets: the numbers the checks use (the real data/chain-snap.yaml and data/chain.yaml, which a printed card's preset never changes). check_characters: Luhn mod N, the first from Wikipedia's Luhn mod N article. good: links and what they say (fields not given are left out). bad: links refused, with the error code and the message. build: fields and the cal value the builder writes; build_bad: fields it refuses.
